AdminUser.title: AdminUser
AdminUser.description: Authorized admin/owner record for POSARA Studio access control.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owner/admin.

email.description: Verified Google email address of the admin.

role.description: Assigned role, strictly owner or admin.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the admin profile was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the admin profile was last updated.

BoothSettings.title: BoothSettings
BoothSettings.description: Private booth configuration controlled exclusively by the POSARA owner.

ownerUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owner managing these booth settings.

autoResetEnabled.description: Whether guest photobooth sessions auto-reset after inactivity.

customWatermarkEnabled.description: Whether custom event branding footer is enabled on photo strips.

kioskPin.description: Owner-configured 4 to 6 digit PIN to unlock Kiosk Guest Mode.

qrisMerchantString.description: Optional merchant static EMVCo QRIS payload string for dynamic checkout QR generation.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when settings were first initialized.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when settings were last updated.

PublicBoothConfig.title: PublicBoothConfig
PublicBoothConfig.description: Non-sensitive public kiosk configuration readable by visitor browsers (contains zero PII and no PIN).

autoResetEnabled.description: Whether guest photobooth sessions auto-reset after 3 minutes of inactivity.

customWatermarkEnabled.description: Whether custom event branding footer is active on rendered photo strips.

watermarkText.description: Custom event branding label shown on strip footer.

qrisMerchantString.description: Public static merchant QRIS payload string used to derive dynamic transaction QR codes.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when public booth config was last synced.

UserPlan.title: UserPlan
UserPlan.description: Subscription tier and monthly photo credit quota for a registered POSARA user.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the user.

email.description: Verified email address of the user.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the user plan was initialized.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the user plan was last updated.

UpgradeRequest.title: UpgradeRequest
UpgradeRequest.description: Customer subscription upgrade and QRIS confirmation request reviewed by the POSARA owner.

requestId.description: Unique document ID for the upgrade request.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the requesting user.

email.description: Verified Google email address of the requesting user.

displayName.description: Display name of the requesting user.

billingCycle.description: Billing cycle selected by the customer.

invoiceNumber.description: Unique Order Invoice number generated per transaction.

paymentNote.description: Optional transfer or sender note provided by the user.

status.description: Review state of the upgrade request.

reviewedByEmail.description: Owner email that approved or rejected the request, empty while pending.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the request was submitted.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the request was last updated.

CheckoutThrottle.title: CheckoutThrottle
CheckoutThrottle.description: Server-enforced per-user cooldown state preventing upgrade_requests flooding.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the user.

latestRequestId.description: Most recent upgrade_requests document ID submitted by this user.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp enforced for 60-second cooldown checks.

/admins/{adminId}.description: Stores verified admin/owner access records keyed by Firebase Auth UID.

/booth_settings/{settingId}.description: Stores owner-only photobooth kiosk PIN and private owner configuration.

/public_booth_config/{configId}.description: Stores non-sensitive public kiosk configuration (auto-reset, event branding, merchant QRIS).

/user_plans/{userId}.description: Stores per-user subscription tier and monthly photo credit quota.

/upgrade_requests/{requestId}.description: Stores customer subscription upgrade confirmation requests reviewed by the owner.

/checkout_throttles/{userId}.description: Per-user 60-second anti-spam cooldown lock paired with upgrade_requests creation.
